transcript: Oh, hi! I'm Ray, the stingray who lives inside Fabricator.
Building a Rayfin app usually means juggling CLIs, Copilot, git and a browser… whoa. The room is spinning.
Fabricator puts it all in one window.
Name your app, and I'll swim it over to Microsoft Fabric. Hey, that's me! Fins crossed.

And on deploy, Rayfin sets up your whole backend, automatically: database, APIs, auth, storage, functions and hosting. Scalable, governed, and inside your organization's boundary. You didn't lift a fin.
Then describe what you want, in plain English. GitHub Copilot writes the code… and I cheer!
Your app runs live, right next to the chat. See something to change? Point at it in Design, and ask.
After every successful chat turn, Fabricator redeploys your app. It's live! Then share it with people in your organization.
The Advisor grades your app's health. Blueprint maps how it all connects. And if something breaks, I'll dig through the logs with you.
It runs on the GitHub Copilot account you already have. Download Fabricator, and come say hi!
Psst… a group of stingrays is called a fever. I'm not making that up.
